Cunard's Grill Suites
The luxury of time
Leave the details to us and embrace every moment. Relax in dedicated and secluded spaces, behold the theatre of dining, and experience the height of White Star Service.
Watch the Grill Suites film
The Grill Suites experience
Two ways to experience Grill Suites
We've been refining the personalised service of our Grill Suites for over a century. Priority embarkation. A dedicated concierge. Menus that are more like suggestions. And in Queens Grill Suites, a butler to take care of everything you could possibly need. Your suite itself is a sophisticated sanctuary, where every touch has been meticulously considered.
Dedicated service
The Grill Suites Concierge and priority embarkation. In Queens Grill Suites, your butler
The finest dining
A table reserved just for you in the Queens Grill or Princess Grill Restaurant
Exclusive access
The Grill Suites Lounge and the Grill Suites Terrace
Highest levels of comfort
Spacious suites with sweeping balconies

Princess Grill Suites
The essence of Grill Suites luxury
Let us invite you into a Princess Grill Suite, the perfect way to step into the essence of Cunard's Grill Suites luxury. Spacious suites. Exclusive fine dining. An invitation to private retreats, both inside and out. Every detail has been considered for your comfort.
Spacious suites with a private balcony, on all four Queens
Princess Grill Restaurant, at a table reserved just for you
Your suite steward and the Grill Suites Concierge

For those seeking the exceptional
Queens Grill Suites have always been designed for those seeking the exceptional. From butler service to bespoke dining in the Queens Grill Restaurant, every detail is tailored to you. This is the pinnacle of luxury ocean travel.
Our largest suites, up to the 2,249 sq ft Grand Duplex
Queens Grill Restaurant, and you can order off-menu

Queens Grill
Queens Grill Suites
Queens Grill Suites have always been designed for those seeking the exceptional. Our largest and most luxurious suites bring with them a refined comfort that quietly wows.
Watch the Queens Grill film
What makes Queens Grill Suites special
Space, privacy and personal service
Relaxed days provide space to simply slow down. Watch the sunrise from your expansive balcony. Opt for a leisurely breakfast in bed. Your butler anticipates your every wish, from stocking your complimentary bar with your favourites and delivering canapés, to pressing your chosen party wear just so.
Your butler
A butler and assistant butler, from unpacking to pressing your party wear
Queens Grill Restaurant
A table reserved just for you. Order off-menu, or dine in your suite
Exclusive access
The Grill Suites Lounge and the Grill Suites Terrace
Highest levels of comfort
Laurent-Perrier on arrival, a complimentary bar, daily canapés

Life in Queens Grill
Considered in every detail
Spend a peaceful afternoon on the private Grill Suites Terrace, enjoying the ocean breeze. Make your way to the Grill Suites Lounge, where a familiar face waits to offer, ‘your usual?’. When it's time to eat, your table is always set and waiting in the elegant Queens Grill Restaurant. Here, extraordinary cuisine and tableside theatre impresses again and again.

Life in Princess Grill
The luxury of time
Indulge in the luxury of time, as hidden corners of your ship await. Relax in the private Grill Suites Lounge. Sunbathe on the Grill Suites Terrace. Your Grill Suites Concierge is on hand to take care of any arrangements, from booking Shore Experiences to ordering a surprise bouquet of flowers for someone special on board. Embrace the Grill Suites lifestyle from the moment your voyage begins.

Cunard's Grill Suites
The luxury of time
Leave the details to us and embrace every moment. Relax in dedicated and secluded spaces, behold the theatre of dining, and experience the height of White Star Service.
Watch the Grill Suites film
The Grill Suites experience
Two ways to experience Grill Suites
We've been refining the personalised service of our Grill Suites for over a century. Priority embarkation. A dedicated concierge. Menus that are more like suggestions. And in Queens Grill Suites, a butler to take care of everything you could possibly need. Your suite itself is a sophisticated sanctuary, where every touch has been meticulously considered.

Princess Grill Suites
The essence of Grill Suites luxury
Let us invite you into a Princess Grill Suite, the perfect way to step into the essence of Cunard's Grill Suites luxury. Spacious suites. Exclusive fine dining. An invitation to private retreats, both inside and out. Every detail has been considered for your comfort.

Queens Grill
Queens Grill Suites
Queens Grill Suites have always been designed for those seeking the exceptional. Our largest and most luxurious suites bring with them a refined comfort that quietly wows.

What makes Queens Grill Suites special
Space, privacy and personal service
Relaxed days provide space to simply slow down. Watch the sunrise from your expansive balcony. Opt for a leisurely breakfast in bed. Your butler anticipates your every wish, from stocking your complimentary bar with your favourites and delivering canapés, to pressing your chosen party wear just so.

Practical questions
Questions, answered
The practical things guests ask before they book Queens Grill.
You can dine whenever the impulse takes you, and for however long you wish, at a table that's reserved just for you. You can order off-menu, and the restaurant menu is also served in your suite.
Your butler and assistant butler anticipate your every wish, from unpacking and pressing to stocking your complimentary bar with your favourites and delivering daily pre-dinner canapés.

Life in Queens Grill
A club within a club
Spend a peaceful afternoon on the private Grill Suites Terrace, enjoying the ocean breeze. Make your way to the Grill Suites Lounge, where a familiar face waits to offer, ‘your usual?’. When it's time to eat, your table is always set and waiting in the elegant Queens Grill Restaurant. Here, extraordinary cuisine and tableside theatre impresses again and again.

A day in the Queens Suite
More than a suite. A considered way to travel.
There's a sense of intrigue with Cunard's Grill Suites with considered touches that elevate the experience. From décor to dining, we work with the very best. Discover the finest way to sail, finessed over more than a century.
